title: fwreskip G1: let the Mac record the iPhone screen
instructions: A macOS prompt may ask to let the terminal control QuickTime Player: click OK (or Don't Allow if you'd rather start each recording yourself). A QuickTime window showing the iPhone screen will open; leave it, and leave the Mac and the iPhone untouched for about 20 min. Press Done when you have answered the prompt.
